explication: Gravitee APIM is a platform for managing APIs and exposing them through a gateway, with an administrative console and a developer portal. The principal user workflow is to manage and publish APIs in the console, then let developers discover APIs in the portal and subscribe to them; the gateway handles API access. The graph includes the sampled portal routing and service/query layers, plus documented product surfaces. Many server-side and gateway relationships are not established by the excerpts, so those connections are left out rather than inferred.
